test_title: PYST 05: SSC Stenographer - English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 11 Dec 2024 - Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined idiom.

It was just an action __in the nick of time__ that prepared all of us for further arrangements.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. Just in time.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"in the nick of time"** means something that happens at the last possible moment before it is too late. (समय रहते)
 
 
• **Example:** We got to the station just in the nick of time to catch the train.
 
 
 
• **"Just in time"** refers to something happening exactly at the necessary or last possible moment. (समय पर)
 
 
• **Example:** The ambulance arrived just in time to save the patient's life.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. Just in time.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Delayed as expected** (जैसा अपेक्षित था विलंबित): Refers to something that happens later than planned or anticipated.
 
 
• **Example:** The flight was delayed as expected due to bad weather.
 
 
 
• **Unnatural happenings** (अप्राकृतिक घटनाएं): Refers to events that do not occur naturally or are out of the ordinary.
 
 
• **Example:** The sudden appearance of the eclipse was considered an unnatural happening by the villagers.
 
 
 
• **Forceful labour** (जबरदस्ती का श्रम): Refers to work that is done under compulsion or with great effort.
 
 
• **Example:** The construction workers were subjected to forceful labour to meet the tight deadline.
 
 

5f:Tce1,
The correct answer is **Option 3**.
